description: This file defines the FontHandler class responsible for measuring, converting, and handling font objects within the MigraDoc rendering system. It includes methods for converting DOM fonts to XFonts, calculating font metrics, and managing font caching.

classes.name: FontHandler
classes.description: A utility class for font measurement, conversion, and caching within the MigraDoc rendering process.

methods.name: FontToXFont
methods.description: Converts a MigraDoc Font object to an XFont, utilizing caching with WeakReferences for performance.

methods.name: GetXStyle
methods.description: Determines the XFontStyleEx based on the properties (bold, italic) of a Font.

methods.name: GetDescent
methods.description: Calculates the descent metric for a given XFont.

methods.name: GetAscent
methods.description: Calculates the ascent metric for a given XFont.

methods.name: GetSubSuperScaling
methods.description: Computes scaling factor for subscript/superscript fonts based on font metrics.

methods.name: ToSubSuperFont
methods.description: Creates a scaled XFont suitable for subscript or superscript text.

methods.name: FontColorToXBrush
methods.description: Converts a MigraDoc Font color to an XBrush, considering CMYK color mode.
